The '''Data Dead Drop''' was a common and inexpensive tool used by embedded [[Agent/Legends|agents]] and informants to exchange data covertly. One operative hid a [[Datachip/Legends|datachip]] or encoded message in a hidden compartment within an ordinary item, such as a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowlamp]] or [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]. Later, another operative retrieved the item. Ideally, the exchange attracted no attention, and unsuspecting users of the item failed to notice the hidden modification.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Data Dead Drop was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
